items.what: What a person types into the site check form: their name, their email address and the website address they want checked, plus the check results for that website, the address of the page the form was on, and when the report was sent
items.where: This website's database, as private site check records
items.kept: Until someone deletes it. Deleting the plugin keeps these records.
items.shared: Emailed to the visitor (their report) and emailed to the site's own address (the notify address in Site Check settings, or the site admin email)
items.when: When someone runs a check with the [scout_site_check] form.

items.what: The website address the person asked to check
items.where: Sent to Google's speed tool to measure the site's speed on phones
items.kept: Not kept there by this website

items.what: A scrambled (hashed) form of the visitor's IP address and a scrambled form of their email address, each with a count of checks, used to limit checks to three an hour per connection and three a day per email
items.where: A temporary record in this website's database
items.kept: One hour for the IP address record and one day for the email record
items.when: When someone submits the site check form with a valid name, email and web address.

notes: To run the check, this website also visits the address the person entered, the same way a browser would. Only the website address goes to Google, never the person's name or email.
